title: Menu declutter and user menu fix
summary: Moves Admin into the signed-in user menu, shortens service menu triggers, and fixes the user menu panel so same-origin links and scrolling work reliably.
changes: Admin is opened from the avatar user menu only; the staff chrome no longer shows an Admin mega-menu or panel switch.
Service mega-menu triggers use shorter labels so the top app bar stays on one line on typical desktop widths.
Same-origin workspace links in the user menu stay in-app instead of being treated as external.
The user menu panel is opaque and scrollable, and keyboard focus lands on the first menu item when it opens.
affected_areas: Workspace shell and top app bar
Staff mega menus and navigation builder
Workspace shell help and design notes
version_rationale: PATCH: navigation declutter and user-menu reliability; no new product surface and nothing removed from Admin itself.
validation: PHPUnit navigation, shell, WorkspaceUrl and related coverage.
Herd preview at https://myapes-account.test for CIC, Shelter, Clinic and Clients with Admin via the user menu.
composer milestone:bump -- v0.75.1 --check and myapes:changelog-validate against origin/main.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release tag (v0.75.0). No database migrations in this release.
